precedence: This v3 amendment supersedes v2 as the effective Auth-lane boundary. The v1 and v2 allowlisted paths remain effective only under their original conditions, except where v3 supplies a stricter exact path, filename or semantic rule. All predecessor denials and false authority flags remain in force.

retainedPredecessorAllowances.rule: The exact closed set below supersedes every predecessor wildcard for this run. A conditionally described owner registry path is not admitted now; if fail-closed generation later proves it necessary, work must stop for a new append-only exact-path amendment.

closedSetRule: The backend v49 Auth-lane commit may change only files in effectiveExactChangedPathClosedSet. Presence of any other changed path is a hard denial and requires a new append-only exact-path decision before work continues.

End-to-end ELEVATED allow remains blocked until a separate exact trusted-carrier decision.
requiredBehavior: A NORMAL request to either exact PAY read route returns a step-up-required challenge and no protected response payload.

No body, path or expected-object-version command binding is synthesized for either read route.
Missing, stale or malformed decision context denies access.

timeGenericSessionStepUpGeneratorExcepti.purpose: Permit the already authorized contract generators and exact v49 tests to represent generic session step-up independently from fresh command-bound step-up for PEP-TIM-022 through PEP-TIM-026.
timeGenericSessionStepUpGeneratorExcepti.scopeRule: The exception may add the minimum generic-session-step-up representation and validation only; it may not change TIME business behavior, active access modes, approvals, SoD predicates or wire bindings.

backendReceiptProofRequired: Exact changed-path manifest is a subset of effectiveExactChangedPathClosedSet; predecessor globs do not admit any additional path for this run.
Every changed file has an exact SHA-256 and a stated necessity tied to one authorization invariant.
All PAGE and DATA route tuples exactly equal central-authorization-decision-amendment.v3.json.
HRM and PAY shared PAGE/DATA wire bindings carry the exact declared wire-authority equivalence key and no other unkeyed collision exists.
PAY targeted Gateway tests prove fail-closed NORMAL challenge; isolated Auth policy tests may prove explicitly supplied ELEVATED evaluation, but no end-to-end ELEVATED allow is claimed.
TIM targeted tests prove generic step-up on all five operations and fresh command-bound evidence only on close and reopen.
The V257 migration and both release-lineage tests prove immutable v49 discovery and checksum binding only.
No business/domain source, activation, tenant enrollment or module migration was changed.
explicitDenialsAfterAmendment: All HRM, PAY, SYS, TIM and PER business controllers, application services and domain services remain forbidden.
Payroll V52, Platform V331, Time V12, People V57 and Notification V36 authoring remains forbidden.
Capability splitting to emulate step-up semantics remains forbidden.
Feature activation, tenant enrollment and tenant-specific override remain forbidden.
Push, dwp-dev merge and owner-module start-token issuance remain forbidden.

residualBlockingDecision.problem: Auth policy and Gateway challenge interception cannot complete PAY ELEVATED read because the current Gateway request context remains NORMAL and does not carry a trusted fresh elevated Auth-session access mode.
pathsNotAuthorizedByV3: Gateway identity or elevated-session carrier implementation paths
residualBlockingDecision.requiredSuccessor: A separate append-only v4 decision and token must select exact source-backed paths, trust boundary, freshness evidence, downgrade behavior and targeted tests before any end-to-end ELEVATED allow implementation.
